title: SM ST9C
text: 离散时间或连续时间同步电机 ST9C 静态励磁系统，带有自动电压调节器，输入 10 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} 指定初始输出电压、{Initial terminal voltage, Vt0 (pu)} 指定初始机端电压、{Initial terminal current, It0 (pu)} 指定初始机端电流、{Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} 指定补偿电阻、{Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} 指定补偿电抗、{Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} 调节器时间常数、{Time constant of differential part of AVR, T_CD (s)} 指定 AVR 微分部分的时间常数、{RegFilter time constant of differential part of AVR, T_BD (s)} 指定 AVR 微分部分的滤波时间常数、{Dead-band for differential part influence on AVR, Z_A (1)} 指定微分部分对 AVR 影响的死区、{AVR gain, K_A (1)} 指定 AVR 增益、{Gain associated with activation of takeover UEL, K_U (1)} 指定与激活 takeover UEL 相关联的增益、{Time constant of AVR, T_A (s)} 指定 AVR 的时间常数、{Time constant of underexcitation limiter, T_AUEL (s)} 指定欠励限制器的时间常数、{Maximum regulator output, V_Rmax (pu)} 调节器最大输出、{Minimum regulator output, V_Rmin (pu)} 调节器最小输出、{Power converter gain (proportional to supply voltage), K_AS (pu)} 指定功率变换器增益、{Equivalent time constant of power converter firing control, T_AS (s)} 指定功率变换器触发控制的时间常数、{Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} 指定 OEL 输入位置、{Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} 指定 UEL 输入位置、{Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} 指定 SCL 输入位置、{Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)} 指定整流器负载系数、{Potential circuit (voltage) gain coefficient, K_P (pu)} 指定电势电路电压增益系数、{Potential circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I (pu)} 指定电势电路电流增益系数、{Reactance associated with the compound source, X_L (pu)} 指定复合电源电抗、{Potential circuit phase angle (degrees)} 指定电势电路相位角、{Maximum limit on exciter voltage based on supply condition, V_Bmax (pu)} 指定励磁机电压上限、{Switch to select exciter supply configuration} 指定电源选择器 Position A: power source derived from generator terminal，按实例取值。
